title: CriteriaSet
description: The acceptance-criteria contract, spec §5. Frozen and content-hashed on approval; immutable after implementation begins — see AcceptanceCriteriaContract.md in this package for the rules this schema enforces structurally.

status.description: draft: agent may still edit. frozen: contentHash is set, criteria are immutable, evaluator may run.

contentHash.description: Required when status=frozen. Computed over the canonical JSON of `criteria` (sorted keys, no whitespace) at approval time.

approvedBy.description: auto_low_risk is reserved for a future policy tier; MVP always requires "user".

id.description: e.g. AC-DASH-01. Human-legible; referenced directly in reports and generated test names.

observable.description: What is measured — e.g. "player world-space displacement over 0.30s following Dash input".

expected.description: Shape depends on `type`; deliberately loose here and validated more strictly by the evaluator, since expected-value shapes vary widely (ranges, booleans, event sequences).

tolerance.description: Optional — required in practice for any numeric behavioral criterion. E.g. {"kind": "absolute", "value": 0.05}.

mandatory.description: false = advisory. Spec §5 rule: a task cannot have mandatory criteria that are ALL type=visual — enforced by validators, not by this schema alone (cross-field).

evidenceMethod.description: e.g. "position trace + replay event log". Free text at MVP; becomes an enum once the probe/evidence taxonomy stabilizes past M2.

negativeControlOf.description: If this criterion is the required negative control for a suppression criterion (spec §5, AC-DASH-02 example), points at that criterion's id.

confidence.description: deterministic: hidden assertion decides it. probabilistic: statistical/threshold-based. subjective: routes to human review regardless of automated result.

runs.description: Per-run outcome, spec §8 — at least 2 runs required before status can be pass/fail; disagreement forces status=unstable.
